summary: Iteration 6 verification — X-ray upload fix + auto server/client image compression for Eayadati. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py. POST /api/patients/{id}/xrays accepts multipart image and returns {id, storage_path, size, original_size, content_type, filename, uploaded_at}. Large JPEG (3000x2200 photographic noise, ~2.1MB) is compressed server-side via Pillow (_compress_image: EXIF-transpose → longest side <= 1600px → JPEG q60 optimize) — verified size < 0.7 * original_size and content_type normalized to 'image/jpeg'. Tiny 100x100 JPEG q50 is NOT grown (size <= original_size) — compression only replaces bytes when strictly smaller, exactly per spec. Empty file → 400 as required. Non-image (text/plain) → 200 with graceful fallback (compression path skipped, stored as-is, size == original_size). GET /api/patients/{id}/xrays lists uploads; GET /api/xrays/{id}/file?token= returns bytes (200); missing token → 401; DELETE /api/xrays/{id} → 200 and removes from list. Regressions all pass: public patient portal /api/public/patient/{token} still returns {clinic,patient,chart,invoices,financials}; partial PATCH preserves untouched fields (medical_history set, full_name unchanged); dental chart persists (tooth 11 caries); invoice currency SYP and USD round-trip; RBAC: assistant GET /api/invoices → 403 when show_financials_to_assistants=false. FRONTEND (Expo web, 390x844, RTL): Login as doctor@demo.com succeeds → /dashboard → /patients → first patient row → patient page loads with 'الصور الشعاعية' section. testID='upload-xray-btn' present, compression hint 'يتم ضغط الصورة تلقائياً قبل الحفظ لتوفير المساحة مع الحفاظ على وضوح التفاصيل.' visible, button label 'رفع صورة شعاعية' visible. Triggered file chooser → uploaded a real 815KB noise JPEG (2400x1800) → after ~7s the gallery shows a new thumbnail (total 3 ) with contentFit='cover'; no xray-error text appeared. End-to-end upload works and the client-side expo-image-manipulator (resize 1600, JPEG q60) also runs (visible in earlier /xrays PUT calls succeeding). No red screen. Non-blocking carry-overs: RN-Web 'shadow*' & 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings and dev-static 404s (Metro preview) — all cosmetic, unchanged from iters 1-5.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:261 _compress_image correctly uses ImageOps.exif_transpose, longest-side clamp to 1600, JPEG q60 optimize, and returns None on exception — safety-net design confirmed.

server.py:601 upload_xray reads bytes → 400 on empty → applies compression ONLY when content_type startswith 'image/' AND compressed is strictly smaller than original — matches iteration 6 spec exactly.
server.py:632 normalizes content_type to 'image/jpeg' only when the compressed bytes are actually chosen — no false normalization for non-images or already-tiny images.
server.py:645 GET /xrays/{id}/file accepts ?token= for use on web; returns 401 without token — verified via test_iteration6.
frontend/src/api.ts:96 uploadXray: on web fetches uri → blob → FormData; on native attaches {uri,name,type} — both paths correct.

frontend/app/patient/[id].tsx:81 pickXray: correctly skips media-library permission on web (Platform.OS !== 'web' guard), calls expo-image-manipulator (resize 1600 + q0.6 JPEG) then uploads, and shows testID='xray-error' banner on failure — visible error path per spec.
frontend/app/patient/[id].tsx:244 hint '<compression note>' is a plain Text child (RTL) inside SectionCard — accessibility OK.

context_for_next_testing_agent: X-ray endpoints: POST /api/patients/{pid}/xrays (multipart 'file'), GET /api/patients/{pid}/xrays, GET /api/xrays/{id}/file?token=<jwt>, DELETE /api/xrays/{id}. Response includes original_size and size (post-compression). Compression is applied only when file.content_type starts with 'image/' AND the compressed result is strictly smaller. Empty file → 400. Non-image → stored as-is (size == original_size). Frontend testIDs on patient page: upload-xray-btn (Pressable), xray-error (Text banner). Login → /dashboard, then /patients → click any [data-testid^='patient-row-'] to reach /patient/{id}. Upload via file chooser: use `async with page.expect_file_chooser(): await page.click('[data-testid="upload-xray-btn"]', force=True)` — expo-image-picker on web opens native file dialog. Auth token still stored in localStorage 'eayadati_token'. When running pytest, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL must be exported (pytest doesn't auto-load /app/backend/.env from /app cwd).
rca_of_issue: N/A — iteration 6 is a bug-fix + feature verification; the X-ray upload bug was fixed by (a) removing media-library permission gating on web, (b) using expo-image-manipulator to pre-compress before FormData upload, (c) adding server-side Pillow safety-net, (d) 400 on empty file, (e) surfacing failures via visible testID='xray-error' banner. All five behaviors verified via pytest + browser automation.
